title: Moonplayshader
description: Moonplayshader brings dynamic shadows, vibrant colors, and smooth performance for every device. High FPS, low lag, better visuals.
body:
# MoonPlayShader

MoonPlayShader is a lightweight Minecraft shader focused on improving shadows, colors, and overall visuals while keeping FPS high.

## Features
- Dynamic shadows
- Enhanced color vibrance
- Better lighting under trees and structures
- Lightweight and optimized
- High FPS performance
- Low-end and mid-range device friendly

## Compatibility
- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1
- Iris
- OptiFine

## Notes
This shader is designed for players who want better visuals without sacrificing performance.

1. Made by MoonPlay1375 

Lightweight shader with enhanced shadows, better colors, and high FPS performance.
